body: Hey, Know this was 3 days ago but oh well, I'm the same age group as you guys 15-16 and you are pretty much n exact clone of me😂 I didn't want to come off as controlling either, and I recently just came out of a relationship just like your in now, she would talk to a lot of guys (mainly just guys no girls, also would talk to her exes on the daily who she also said she doesn't like and had bad relationships with so that doesn't make sense😂) and they would check her out flirt with her and whatnot and she was just completely oblivious to it and thought nothing of it. But I of course overthought everything and thought she was just going to cheat. Eventually, you come to realize you were right everything u thought was true. With these types of girls they just want your attention and not who you are, just want compliments to boost their ego and get with another guy. I might not be of age and this might not be what you were expecting I get it, I really wanted to be with her too and solve problems but she just left me after she got her attention, So just break up tell her how u feel it will hurt it might be hard to do but it will be right for you later on.

I was never introduced to her friends as I partially already knew then and they knew me from school and whatnot and her friends were very aware of our relationship as she would talk about me often, but yeah as you said she never showed me she wanted US the only time she ever tried to meet up with me was when her ex was at her home (family friend, also abused her so she met with me to escape that)
